messages:
alex: Hey team, trying to kick off the rolling prod release for web-service v1.3.2 during the 18:00-19:00 change window. Can anyone with prod deploy perms confirm they can run the canary?
maria: I can if deploy-bot lets me. ran a dry-run locally, all green.
ryan: Heads up — I just got a `permission denied` from deploy-bot earlier. It said my account isn't in the `prod-deployers` group and MFA check failed.
deploy-bot: audit: request=deploy start env=prod user=ryan status=denied reason="missing-group, mfa-not-enrolled"
lisa: @ryan did you finish the MFA onboarding? the new policy requires hardware token for prod.
ryan: I did sms TOTP but not the security key. I thought the old rule still applied.
oncall-bot: reminder: change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Emergency rollback playbook pinned in #incidents.
maria: We can't delay the canary — it's a small patch and we want quick validation. Options: 1) add ryan temporarily to prod-deployers (requires SOC approval), 2) have someone else run it, 3) use JIT elevation.
alex: I can run it, but I'm two floors away from my security key and CI will prompt for U2F. Anyone else able to do it immediately?
ryan: If someone can run, please also pin the version and enable version-locking so we can rollback to v1.3.1 quickly if needed.
lisa: Good call. Use `--pin v1.3.2` flag in deploy-bot to create a pinned tag in release registry. Example: `deploy-bot start --env prod --version v1.3.2 --canary 10% --pin`
maria: Also add a short note to release notes: "hotfix: session cookie serialization" so SRE can correlate errors.
deply-bot (typo in earlier message): oops
deploy-bot: action required: to grant temporary prod-deploy role, run `/jira create PROD-JIT-<shortdesc>` and ping @security on the ticket. JIT auto-expires in 2 hours.
ryan: I'll open the JIT ticket now and ping security.
maria: If security approves, ensure the ticket includes rollback steps and the exact `canary` percent. SRE wants observability gates at 5 and 30 minutes.
lisa: Copying runbook snippet:```
Rollback plan:
1) `deploy-bot rollback --env prod --version v1.3.1`
2) watch metrics: error-rate, p50 latency, session-drop-rate
3) escalate to oncall if error-rate > 3% for 10m
```
alex: Perfect. @ryan please post the JIT ticket here once it's created so I can stand by.
ryan: Ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROD-JIT-3245 — pinged @security. Description: quick canary for v1.3.2, pin + rollback plan attached.
security: review: PROD-JIT-3245 granted temporary `prod-deployer` role to ryan for 2h (requires U2F enrollment after). Reason: low-risk hotfix canary. :white_check_mark:
maria: Nice, thanks. @ryan can you re-run the deploy command?
ryan: Running now: `deploy-bot start --env prod --version v1.3.2 --canary 10% --pin`
deploy-bot: deploy started by=rayan status=canary percent=10 pinned=true trace_id=tx_9abc123
ryan: Canaries are up. Observability gates scheduled at +5m and +30m.
alex: Fingers crossed. If everything looks good at +30m we can gradually ramp to 100% and close the ticket. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: monitor: gate1 passed, error-rate=0.2% at +5m
maria: Gate1 OK. continuing watch.
oncall-bot: monitor: gate2 passed, error-rate=0.3% at +30m
ryan: Ramp to 50% then 100% per runbook. `deploy-bot promote --env prod --to 50`
deploy-bot: promote action accepted. new canary=50%
alex: Once at 100% we'll add the release note and close the JIT ticket. Thanks all.
security: reminder: ryan please enroll U2F before the next prod push.
lisa: noted. I'll add a quick doc link for U2F enrollment: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/u2f-enroll
ryan: Will do. Closing thread after we verify full ramp. :white_check_mark:
